transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1222 Fern Basin Drive?
Yes, this is 1222 Fern Basin Drive. I’m here with two people. No water inside. I can help with a boat.
Thanks for confirming and offering to help with a boat. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Two people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know about the people here. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or medical needs.
Understood, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
Thanks for letting us know you’re okay. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I don’t have a truck or boat, but I can help with free seats if needed.
Thanks for sharing what you can offer. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Two people. No water inside yet.
Got it. Two people. No water inside yet. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
